name: kiwishare-monorepo
description: Monorepo for KiwiShare - Mobile App (Flutter) and Backend Server (Koa + TypeScript + MongoDB)

scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install --ignore-scripts && cd mobile && flutter pub get
scripts.mobile:format: cd mobile && dart format --set-exit-if-changed lib/ test/
scripts.mobile:build:ios: export LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 && cd mobile && flutter build ios --release --no-codesign
scripts.mobile:build:all: pnpm run mobile:build:android && pnpm run mobile:build:ios
scripts.mobile:dev: export LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 && cd mobile && flutter run --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=https://kiwishare.onrender.com
scripts.mobile:dev:local: export LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 && cd mobile && flutter run --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=local
scripts.mobile:dev:device: export LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 && cd mobile && flutter run --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=http://$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 || ipconfig getifaddr en1 || echo localhost):3000
scripts.build:all: pnpm run server:build && pnpm run mobile:build:all
scripts.test:all: pnpm run mobile:test && pnpm run server:test
scripts.lint:all: pnpm run mobile:analyze && pnpm run server:lint
